name: wobble-card
blurb: Card tilts and wobbles toward the cursor with parallax inner content.
description: Motion wrapper that tracks pointer position and applies translate/scale transforms to create a 3D tilt effect. Outer card moves toward cursor while inner content scales and counter-translates for parallax depth. Includes noise texture overlay.
use_when: Hero feature cards or CTAs that need eye-catching interactivity on desktop hover.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices or dark-themed pages; component hardcodes indigo-800 background.
a11y: No keyboard interaction; focus handling not managed. Motion plays on hover but children remain accessible.
